description: This file defines an Android activity class 'Animation' that demonstrates various custom animations for transitioning between activities. It includes setup for button click handlers triggering different animation effects like fade, zoom, scale up, and thumbnail zoom, utilizing Android's ActivityOptions for animation effects.

classes.name: Animation
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating various transition animations between activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures button click listeners for different animation effects.

methods.name: onEnterAnimationComplete
methods.description: Logs completion of the enter animation.
